title: Product Marginals and Exponentially Slow Spectra of Positive Ising Transfer Kernels
abstract: Fix a positive Ising coupling. We construct strictly positive weights on Boolean cubes whose labelled marginals on every set of at most a fixed positive fraction of the coordinates equal the uniform product marginals, while exponentially many normalized eigenvalues of the weighted transfer kernel approach one exponentially fast in the number of coordinates. The stationary law of the Perron Doob transform has exactly the same marginals as well. The unweighted product kernel has a dimension-independent gap. The construction combines binary codes with positive primal and dual distances, a positive product admixture, and a finite block-norm estimate. We prove the coding input by a direct entropy union bound and give explicit finite spectral constants. As a negative control, we calculate the full transfer spectrum of a single positive parity tilt: unlike its single-site heat-bath gap, its transfer gap stays uniformly positive at fixed coupling. The ingredients are classical; the contribution considered here is their joint transfer and stationary-marginal conclusion, whose external priority is not established. The weights allow global many-body dependence and exponentially small probabilities. No fixed-range Gibbs or local-dynamics claim follows.
